caption: The video captures a stainless steel saucepan resting on a gas stovetop, viewed from a high angle, its long handle angled toward the upper right corner. The pan is filled with clear water in which numerous ice cubes of varying sizes float clustered across the surface. Black grate bars frame the pan on either side, a speckled granite counter edge appears at the left, and white control knobs sit at the lower right, remaining in place throughout. The overall arrangement of the ice and water appears largely unchanged, with no obvious translation or rotation of individual cubes. No boiling or sustained bubbling is apparent, and the water surface and ice edges look calm. A small circular bright spot on the right side of the ice cluster becomes noticeable after a short interval and then persists, while the surrounding ice holds its position. The framing and lighting appear constant throughout.
